summary: @dogtrax #smallpoems Doors and corners of time unfold to envelop realities as two specks drawn together collapse inward driving their energy apart so they stay frosted windows, dew covered toes carried together, forever separated on the winds of a fallen star
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
@dogtrax #smallpoems
Doors and corners
of time unfold to
envelop realities
as two specks
drawn together
collapse inward
driving
their energy apart
so they stay
frosted windows, dew covered
toes
carried together, forever separated
on the winds of a fallen star
